description: This Java class 'RelatedEdgesSourcingListener' listens for specific entity events (assignment/unassignment to edges and deletion) within the Thingsboard platform, and triggers related edge ID eviction events via a service. It manages an executor service for asynchronous processing and uses Spring annotations for event handling.

classes.name: RelatedEdgesSourcingListener
classes.description: A Spring component that listens for entity-related events and triggers related edge eviction processes asynchronously.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the executor service for handling event processing asynchronously.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Shuts down the executor service during bean destruction.

methods.name: handleEvent (ActionEntityEvent)
methods.description: Handles assignment/unassignment events to edges and triggers eviction.

methods.name: handleEvent (DeleteEntityEvent)
methods.description: Handles entity deletion events and triggers eviction if conditions are met.
